title: Canonical Creator Handle Read Overlay
summary: Make authenticated creator profile reads expose handle state exclusively from the canonical Sesh creator handle reservation record without synchronizing or trusting duplicated profile JSON handle state.
invariants: The canonical handle ownership record remains sesh_creator_handle_reservations.
SeshCreatorProfile.handle remains a legacy-compatible serialized field but is not authoritative for handle ownership.
Authenticated profile reads resolve the creator first, load the canonical profile, then overlay handle state from the reservation repository by the exact authenticated SeshCreatorId.
A canonical reservation causes the returned profile handle to equal reservation.normalizedHandle.
No reservation causes the returned profile handle to be absent even if persisted profile JSON contains a stale legacy handle.
Reservation storage or validation failure causes the profile operation to fail closed as unavailable.
A reservation whose creatorId differs from the authenticated profile identity fails closed.
Profile updates remain limited to displayName and bio.
Profile updates do not persist or synchronize handle into the profile record.
The successful profile-update response also overlays canonical reservation handle state so read and update responses share one handle truth.
No handle release, rename, project ownership, collaborator, publishing, management, legal, copyright, CRM, or account rights are inferred.
